_how: PixelLab MCP, 2026-11-20. Still: create_image_pixen(description, width=height=size, no_background=true, outline="single color black outline", detail: "highly detailed" for bosses else "medium detail", view "side" and direction east (analysts) / west (alarms) / south (bosses); none for items). Loop: animate_image(first_frame=the still, action, frame_count=4). Frames 0 (the still) to 4 go in src/<id>_f0..f4.png; node game/art/sprites.js stitches them. Scenes (hero, back, win_*) are opaque, no_background=false, detail "highly detailed", at the size given. Situations are sit_<id> (sit_coffee, sit_intel would clash with the items). die_blank is a still only, traced into art/die.js.
